a.name: Masthead
a.description: Two-tier front page: the headline with a delivery note ruled off beside it, then photo, deck and actions in three ruled columns.
a.differs_from: The photo sits under the headline tier with the actions ruled off beside it, a media position no built hero uses; framed by rules, not a band or card.

b.name: Litter filmstrip
b.description: Deep-steel panel inset in the page; the six puppies run as a contact strip along its foot, copy in two columns above.
b.differs_from: The photos sit under the copy, a media position no built hero uses, in an inset panel rather than a band or card; the mosaics are grids beside or above the copy.

c.name: Rail ticket
c.description: A blue puppy photo fills the whole band behind the copy, printed on a notched bone ticket card with a Carlisle to London route line.
c.differs_from: The photo is the background of the whole band under an overlaid ticket card, which no built hero does; built heroes put the photo beside or above the copy.
